spans.author: Ana Duarte
spans.quote:
Lena,

As discussed this afternoon, for signature.

"Acme Org confirms that user acceptance testing for core replenishment has been completed
satisfactorily for the 25 store pilot cohort, covering ambient and dry goods categories.
This sign-off does not extend to fresh categories, which remain in scope for a later
phase, and does not constitute acceptance of the overall programme."

Two UAT defects remain open, both the same root cause on case pack and minimum order
quantity rounding. Both are scheduled for fix this week and neither is a blocker.

Best regards,

spans.author: Lena Fischer
spans.quote:
Signed and attached. The wording is what I asked for, thank you for being careful with it.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

spans.author: Kwame Boateng
spans.quote: Both rounding defects fixed and re-tested. Nine of nine scenarios now pass.
